annotations.title: Build the phone app for me

description: Build the Android app and hand it back to the person as two files: the app itself (apk), which installs on an Android phone when opened there, and the bundle Google Play asks for (artifact, an .aab), with a step-by-step guide (guide_url) for uploading it themselves. Nothing is charged for the build: it uses about 40 of the plan's build minutes, and needs nothing from them; Google Play itself needs their own developer account ($25, once), which only they can create. For `ios` it answers RELEASE_PLATFORM_UNAVAILABLE: iPhone builds are not available yet. Paid plans only, up to 10 Android builds a month per account (past that it answers PHONE_BUILD_LIMIT_REACHED with the day it resets; once the month's build minutes are used up, USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED, as a deploy would); the app must be a phone app with a live version. Poll with releases; when status is `ready`, give the person apk.download_url to install it on their own phone, and artifact.download_url and guide_url for Google Play. The links work for 30 minutes.

platform.description: android works today; ios answers that iPhone builds are not available yet.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.
